title: ML↔BACK-001: Cloud Inference Output Schema + Backend Serving Requirements (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — there is NO direct §6 contract on either the Edge AI/ML Engineer or the Backend/Cloud Engineer side (EDGE_AI_ML_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Backend; BACKEND_CLOUD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no ML). AgriSpectra inference is primarily on-device (edge); any cloud-side inference is mediated through the MLOps pipeline (ML↔MLOPS-001) and served by the Backend (MLOPS↔BACK-001), with the edge-vs-cloud inference split owned by the Architect (ARCH↔ML-001). This schema reconstructs the plausible direct interface (cloud inference output schema ↔ backend serving requirements) for machine validation; per its x-macp.source_status it mandates a COUNTER. No latency/throughput targets are invented.

ml_cloud_inference_schema.description: ML→BACK: output schema for any cloud-served inference (subordinate to the ARCH edge-vs-cloud split).

unit.description: Explicit unit per physical field; use 'enum'/'probability'/'bool' for non-physical.

inference_location.description: Owned by ARCH↔ML-001; CLOUD/HYBRID is what makes this edge relevant.

backend_serving_requirements.description: BACK→ML: API/serving requirements for ML outputs (via MLOPS↔BACK-001).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Provisional/DERIVED edge — no §6 contract exists on either side; AgriSpectra inference is edge-first and any cloud inference is mediated (ARCH↔ML-001 split; ML↔MLOPS-001; MLOPS↔BACK-001). Agents coordinate provisionally and must COUNTER for ratification.
x-macp.source_status: DERIVED — no direct §6 on either the ML or BACK side; reconstructed from the mediated path (ARCH↔ML-001 / ML↔MLOPS-001 / MLOPS↔BACK-001). Mandates COUNTER (CCR to ratify a §6 contract), not a binding CONFIRM.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisional — to be set by the ratifying §6 contract / CCR)
confirm_conditions: every inference output field and serving requirement (latency/throughput) carries an explicit unit
the edge-vs-cloud inference split defers to ARCH↔ML-001
cloud serving routes through MLOPS↔BACK-001 (model distribution/serving)
reject_conditions: an output field, latency, or throughput quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a cloud-inference deployment that changes the edge-vs-cloud split without ARCH↔ML-001 / an ADR
this DERIVED schema treated as a binding contract — it is provisional pending §6 ratification
counter_conditions: ALWAYS COUNTER: request ratification of a real ML↔BACK §6 contract (or confirm inference is edge-only / mediated) via a CCR before any binding CONFIRM
a serving requirement exceeds the API ceiling (SCALE-4 / PERF-3) — route capacity through ARCH↔BACK-001 with load validation
